referenceGenerator: Built-in ChatGPT image generation with original fist and forearm as separate references
scope: Original fist artwork, finger pixels and forearm rest shape retained; whole forearms and hands attach through rigid rotation and translation
surfacesPerWrist: Original fist with repaired palm base

motionRepair.cause: Blending independently moving hand and forearm vertex fields stretched the wrist despite matching contact points
motionRepair.method: Keep each visible hand and forearm rigid. Use original physics only as a moving attachment frame; apply forearm attachment first, then hand attachment.
motionRepair.validation: Measure every visible mesh edge length and contact separation during continuous live physics, including reversals and return
motionRepair.input: Temporary before-physics gaze values and cursor events in the actual app; original physics retained; no system pointer events
